title: 12 Best Wine Bars in Adelaide
description: Discover Adelaide's top wine bars for 2026. From natural wine havens to classic French bistros, find your perfect pour in the heart of South Australia's wine country. Explore reviews, prices, and insider tips.

places.name: Leigh Street Wine Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of natural wines, paired with their house-made charcuterie.

places.name: Mother Vine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of something rare from their extensive by-the-glass list, with the regional cheese board.

places.name: Hellbound
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their impressive Champagne list by the glass, or a robust Barossa Shiraz.

places.name: Cantina Sociale
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of their rotating Italian white or red, paired with house-made pasta or burrata.

places.name: La Buvette Drinkery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic French varietal like a Sancerre or Beaujolais, complemented by steak frites or an escargot.

places.name: East End Cellars (Bar)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the staff for a recommendation from their vast retail selection to enjoy by the glass (for a small corkage fee), or choose from their curated bar list.

places.name: Fugazzi Bar & Dining Room (Bar Area)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A premium Italian red, like a Barolo or Brunello, paired with a selection of antipasti.

places.name: Apelle
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A unique South Australian white, like a cool-climate Riesling, with their seasonal tasting plate.

places.name: Proof Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Let the friendly staff guide you to an interesting lesser-known varietal, accompanied by their acclaimed cheese toastie.

places.name: Stem Bar & Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Grenache from McLaren Vale, paired with their wood-fired flatbreads and dips.

places.name: Bar La Singara
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the owner for a recommendation from his latest discoveries in natural wines, perhaps a unique orange wine.

places.name: Clara G's
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of sparkling Pét-Nat from the Adelaide Hills, complemented by their creative bar snacks.
